report.title: Launch Playbook for a Thrift Drop Store
channels: Post 3 short try-on reels each week with a "DM to buy" call to action.
Send the drop list to past buyers one day early.
automate: Saved replies for sizes and price
compliance: No licence needed for a very small start; check GST once sales grow
Keep a simple record of every sale
Use clear return rules in your bio
weeks: Review sales and plan drop two
